title: Smoky Fish Fritters
description: A flavorful Indian-inspired dish featuring fish fritters with a smoky twist.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, mix together fish fillets, all-purpose flour, smoky hot sauce, and lemon juice.
2. Using your hands, mix everything together until just combined.
3. In a separate bowl, mix together Canadian flour and a pinch of salt.
4. Using a fork, coat each fish piece with the flour mixture.
5. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
6. Once hot, add the fish fritters and fry until golden brown.
7. Flip the fritters and fry for an additional 2-3 minutes.
8. Remove the fritters from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate.
9. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
